_comment: MANUAL MODE: copy this file to definitions.json and edit. Each parameter you list here will be registered in GA4 as a Custom Dimension (categorical, e.g. difficulty, level_name) or a Custom Metric (numeric, aggregatable, e.g. score, duration_seconds). 'scope' is EVENT or USER. Metric 'unit' is one of STANDARD, CURRENCY, FEET, MILES, METERS, KILOMETERS, MILLISECONDS, SECONDS, MINUTES, HOURS. Remove this _comment key in your real file (optional).

custom_dimensions.description: Name or id of the level being played

custom_metrics.description: Time spent on the level in seconds
